snippet.title: Treasure 'n Trio: Tri-Trailer
snippet.description:
Treasure 'n Trio is a single-player puzzle game based on the classic Sokoban.
Solve puzzles and collect treasures using three characters with different abilities!

The demo version is currently available.

Play Demo & Wishlist Now: https://store.steampowered.com/app/3214530/Treasure_n_Trio/

#indiegame #puzzlegame 





Fonts used in this video:
https://df.nexon.com/data/font/dnfbitbitv2
https://github.com/PriorityInterrupt/dungeon-chunk?tab=readme-ov-file
